text: Implemented incremental TSV and bounded single-member GZIP, strict UTF-8, lexical column projection and generated-stream materialization through ScientificViews/BlobStore/ProjectionReceipt. Source access is rechecked per 64 KiB, all started reads must reach verified EOF, and outputs remain unpublished on failure. New decoder and reference lifecycle cases pass; large resource probes and PostgreSQL checks are in progress. Broader P01/F03/F05 dependencies and full modality qualification remain open.
